AllOf-Input.title: AllOf
AllOf-Input.description: True when every child is true.

AllOf-Output.title: AllOf
AllOf-Output.description: True when every child is true.

AnyOf-Input.title: AnyOf
AnyOf-Input.description: True when at least one child is true.

AnyOf-Output.title: AnyOf
AnyOf-Output.description: True when at least one child is true.

Atr.title: Atr
Atr.description: Average true range: how far price moves in a bar, on average (TradingView's `ta.atr`).

BacktestComparison.title: BacktestComparison
BacktestComparison.description:
A backtest next to the live trades of the same strategy version and symbol entered
during the bars it covered, [period_start, period_end).

symbol.title: Symbol
symbol.description: Symbol the bars belong to, e.g. BTCUSDT

Condition-Input.title: Condition
Condition-Input.description: `left op right` on each bar; a cross means it became true on this bar.

Condition-Output.title: Condition
Condition-Output.description: `left op right` on each bar; a cross means it became true on this bar.

CurrencyPnl.title: CurrencyPnl
CurrencyPnl.description: The P&L of a group's trades quoted in one currency.

Divide-Input.title: Divide
Divide-Input.description: The first operand divided by the second; unknown where the second is 0.

Divide-Output.title: Divide
Divide-Output.description: The first operand divided by the second; unknown where the second is 0.

Emotion.title: Emotion
Emotion.description: How the trader felt, for spotting which states cost money.

EqualHighs.title: EqualHighs
EqualHighs.description: Swing highs at one level, such as a double top (see `EqualLows`).

EqualLows.title: EqualLows
EqualLows.description:
Swing lows at one level, such as a double bottom: true on the bar where the latest of
`times` swing lows is confirmed. The earlier ones began fewer than `within` bars before it
and are within `tolerance_pct` of it, and price held that line in between.

ExitReason.title: ExitReason
ExitReason.description: Why a backtest closed a position.

Happened-Input.title: Happened
Happened-Input.description:
True when the rule held on at least `times` separate runs of bars within the last
`within` bars, this one included. A run that began before the window counts once if it
reaches into it.

Happened-Output.title: Happened
Happened-Output.description:
True when the rule held on at least `times` separate runs of bars within the last
`within` bars, this one included. A run that began before the window counts once if it
reaches into it.

Highest.title: Highest
Highest.description: The highest `source` of the last `period` bars, this one included (`ta.highest`).

JournalContent.title: JournalContent
JournalContent.description: What an entry says. Each published version keeps a snapshot of it.

JournalEntryUpdate.title: JournalEntryUpdate
JournalEntryUpdate.description:
Omitted fields are unchanged; null clears an optional one. Editing a published entry
needs an edit_reason; a draft takes none.

Lowest.title: Lowest
Lowest.description: The lowest `source` of the last `period` bars, this one included (`ta.lowest`).

MarketEntry.title: MarketEntry
MarketEntry.description: Enter at the next bar's open.

buy_and_hold_max_drawdown_pct.title: Buy And Hold Max Drawdown Pct

Metrics.title: Metrics
Metrics.description: Every metric of a backtest; see the functions above for definitions.

Not-Input.title: Not
Not-Input.description:
True when the rule is false and every value it uses is known, so never while an
indicator in it is still warming up.

Not-Output.title: Not
Not-Output.description:
True when the rule is false and every value it uses is known, so never while an
indicator in it is still warming up.

OnTimeframe-Input.title: OnTimeframe
OnTimeframe-Input.description:
An operand computed on bars of a higher `timeframe`, built from the backtest's own bars
in the app's bar sizes (days start at 00:00 UTC). Only completed bars count: a higher bar
counts from the first bar that closes at or after its end, so on a 10:00 bar a daily
SMA(20) is yesterday's.

OnTimeframe-Output.title: OnTimeframe
OnTimeframe-Output.description:
An operand computed on bars of a higher `timeframe`, built from the backtest's own bars
in the app's bar sizes (days start at 00:00 UTC). Only completed bars count: a higher bar
counts from the first bar that closes at or after its end, so on a 10:00 bar a daily
SMA(20) is yesterday's.

OpeningRange.title: OpeningRange

Price.title: Price
Price.description: A field of the current bar, or of an earlier one with `bars_ago`.

PriceEntry-Input.title: PriceEntry
PriceEntry-Input.description:
Enter with an order at `price`, read on the signal bar: a `limit` order fills at that
price or better (a long buys at or below it); a `stop` order fills once price trades
through it (a long buys at or above it). It works for `expires_after` bars from the next
one, unless a newer signal replaces it.

PriceEntry-Output.title: PriceEntry
PriceEntry-Output.description:
Enter with an order at `price`, read on the signal bar: a `limit` order fills at that
price or better (a long buys at or below it); a `stop` order fills once price trades
through it (a long buys at or above it). It works for `expires_after` bars from the next
one, unless a newer signal replaces it.

RealizedCurve.title: RealizedCurve
RealizedCurve.description:
Realized P&L in one quote currency over time: one point per closed trade, in closing
order.

Session.title: Session
Session.description:
When the market trades each day, in its own time zone: an IANA name such as
America/New_York, whose daylight saving is followed. A bar belongs to the trading day whose
session it overlaps; a bar that overlaps none is outside the session. Without a session,
the trading day is the whole UTC day.

Split.title: Split
Split.description: A backtest's metrics before and after its out-of-sample start.

StrategyDefinition-Input.title: StrategyDefinition
StrategyDefinition-Input.description:
The versioned part of a strategy: when to enter, in which direction, and how to get out.

A stop-loss or take-profit is a percentage of the entry price (`_pct`), or a price level
read on the bar whose signal placed the order (`_at`). A take-profit can also be a
multiple of the risk, the distance from the entry to the stop-loss (`take_profit_r`).

StrategyDefinition-Output.title: StrategyDefinition
StrategyDefinition-Output.description:
The versioned part of a strategy: when to enter, in which direction, and how to get out.

A stop-loss or take-profit is a percentage of the entry price (`_pct`), or a price level
read on the bar whose signal placed the order (`_at`). A take-profit can also be a
multiple of the risk, the distance from the entry to the stop-loss (`take_profit_r`).

StrategyUpdate.title: StrategyUpdate
StrategyUpdate.description: Omitted fields are unchanged; only a changed definition creates a new version.

Subtract-Input.title: Subtract
Subtract-Input.description: The first operand minus the second.

Subtract-Output.title: Subtract
Subtract-Output.description: The first operand minus the second.

SwingHigh.title: SwingHigh
SwingHigh.description:
A recent swing high: a bar higher than the `strength` bars on each side of it (see
`SwingLow`).

SwingLow.title: SwingLow
SwingLow.description:
A recent swing low: a bar lower than the `strength` bars on each side of it, known only
`strength` bars after it. `occurrence` 0 is the latest; `output` is its `price` or the
number of bars since it.

TimeOfDay.title: TimeOfDay
TimeOfDay.description:
True on bars that start at or after the first time and before the second, in the
session's time zone (UTC without a session). A first time later than the second wraps past
midnight: ["22:00", "02:00"].

TradeCorrection.title: TradeCorrection
TradeCorrection.description: Fix a closed trade's recorded data. Omitted fields are unchanged; a reason is required.

TradeUpdate.title: TradeUpdate
TradeUpdate.description: Corrections to an open trade: omitted fields are unchanged; exits go through /close.

TradingDay.title: TradingDay
TradingDay.description:
A trading day's open, high, low or close. With `days_ago` 0, today so far: the open of
its first bar in the session, its high and low until now, and this bar's close, unknown
outside the session. With `days_ago` 1 or more, the whole of that many trading days
before, known all day; days without bars in the session don't count.

Value.title: Value
Value.description: A constant, e.g. an RSI threshold.

Vwap.title: Vwap
Vwap.description:
The trading day's volume-weighted average price so far, of each bar's (high + low +
close) / 3; it starts again each day. Unknown outside the session, and on a day's bars
before any volume.
